title: clinopodium neogaeum
intro: Clinopodium neogaeum, commonly known as Mexican oregano, is a flowering plant species in the mint family, native to Mexico and parts of the southwestern United States. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. It is said to have therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral effects, which may help alleviate various health issues, including digestive problems and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Clinopodium neogaeum include essential oils, flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
